description: MANDATORY END-OF-TURN GATE: when a turn reveals multiple durable facts, save them silently before replying. A durable fact left unsaved is a bug. Recall each topic first, reuse canonical concept-level keys (ATOMIC, 1-2 words each — never phrases), and register cross-lingual forms together. Each item: {content, keys, key_types?, namespace?, ttl_seconds?, decay_profile?, related_to?}; decay_profile defaults to standard. Returns saved IDs and is more efficient than multiple remember() calls.
name: remember_batch
